bio: I am an undergraduate Electrical and Electronic Engineering student at East West University with a strong passion for Embedded Systems, Robotics, and hardware innovation.
aboutText1: I am an undergraduate Electrical and Electronic Engineering student at East West University with a strong passion for Embedded Systems, Robotics, and hardware innovation. I enjoy transforming ideas into practical solutions through hands-on projects and continuous experimentation.
aboutText2: My experience includes developing embedded systems, building FPV drones and soccer robots, designing electronic circuits, and simulating systems using MATLAB/Simulink, including 2D floor planning.
